```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democrats believe taxpayer dollars should not flow to employers who steal workers' wages, violate labor laws, engage in union-busting, or exploit immigrant workers to depress working conditions for all workers.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will increase funding and staffing at the Department of Labor to aggressively enforce wage, hour, health, and safety rules across the economy.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats believe employees who are misclassified, including gig and platform workers, deserve wage and workplace protections including minimum wage and overtime pay.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats support using the ABC test to determine employee status.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats believe all workers should be able to hold their employers accountable for unpaid or underpaid wages, regardless of corporate structure.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats support using grants and collaborative relationships with community organizations to ensure that workers know their rights and responsibilities under the law.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will strengthen labor rights for more than 20 million public-sector employees in the United States by passing the Public Service Freedom to Negotiate Act.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Public Service Freedom to Negotiate Act would provide a federal guarantee for public-sector employees to bargain for better pay and benefits and the working conditions they deserve.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
